005package org.wpilib.math.system;
006
007import org.ejml.dense.row.factory.DecompositionFactory_DDRM;
008import org.ejml.simple.SimpleMatrix;
009import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
010import org.wpilib.math.util.Num;
011
012/** Linear system utilities. */
013public final class LinearSystemUtil {
014  private LinearSystemUtil() {
015    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
016  }
017
018  /**
019   * Returns true if (A, B) is a stabilizable pair.
020   *
021   * <p>(A, B) is stabilizable if and only if the uncontrollable eigenvalues of A, if any, have
022   * absolute values less than one, where an eigenvalue is uncontrollable if rank([λI - A, B]) &lt;
023   * n where n is the number of states.
024   *
025   * @param <States> Num representing the size of A.
026   * @param <Inputs> Num representing the columns of B.
027   * @param A System matrix.
028   * @param B Input matrix.
029   * @return If the system is stabilizable.
030   */
031  public static <States extends Num, Inputs extends Num> boolean isStabilizable(
032      Matrix<States, States> A, Matrix<States, Inputs> B) {
033    var es = A.getStorage().eig();
034
035    for (int i = 0; i < A.getNumRows(); ++i) {
036      var e = es.getEigenvalue(i);
037      if (e.getMagnitude() < 1.0 - Math.ulp(1.0)) {
038        continue;
039      }
040
041      // We need to get the rank of a complex matrix, but EJML doesn't have a
042      // complex pivoting QR decomposition. Instead, we'll represent the complex
043      // matrix as a real matrix with twice as many rows and columns.
044      //
045      //   E = [λI - A, B] ∈ ℂᴹˣᴺ
046      //
047      //           [Eᵣ  -Eᵢ]
048      //   E_aug = [Eᵢ   Eᵣ] ∈ ℝ²ᴹˣ²ᴺ
049      //
050      // See https://math.stackexchange.com/a/2012242 for why this works.
051      var E = new SimpleMatrix(A.getNumRows(), A.getNumCols() + B.getNumCols());
052      E.insertIntoThis(
053          0,
054          0,
055          SimpleMatrix.identity(A.getNumRows())
056              .scaleComplex(e.real, e.imaginary)
057              .minus(A.getStorage()));
058      E.insertIntoThis(0, A.getNumCols(), B.getStorage());
059      var E_r = E.real();
060      var E_i = E.imaginary();
061      var E_aug = new SimpleMatrix(2 * E.getNumRows(), 2 * E.getNumCols());
062      E_aug.insertIntoThis(0, 0, E_r);
063      E_aug.insertIntoThis(0, E.getNumCols(), E_i.scale(-1));
064      E_aug.insertIntoThis(E.getNumRows(), 0, E_i);
065      E_aug.insertIntoThis(E.getNumRows(), E.getNumCols(), E_r);
066
067      var qrp = DecompositionFactory_DDRM.qrp(E_aug.getNumRows(), E_aug.getNumCols());
068      if (!qrp.decompose(E_aug.getDDRM()) || qrp.getRank() < 2 * A.getNumRows()) {
069        return false;
070      }
071    }
072    return true;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Returns true if (A, C) is a detectable pair.
077   *
078   * <p>(A, C) is detectable if and only if the unobservable eigenvalues of A, if any, have absolute
079   * values less than one, where an eigenvalue is unobservable if rank([λI - A; C]) &lt; n where n
080   * is the number of states.
081   *
082   * @param <States> Num representing the size of A.
083   * @param <Outputs> Num representing the rows of C.
084   * @param A System matrix.
085   * @param C Output matrix.
086   * @return If the system is detectable.
087   */
088  public static <States extends Num, Outputs extends Num> boolean isDetectable(
089      Matrix<States, States> A, Matrix<Outputs, States> C) {
090    return isStabilizable(A.transpose(), C.transpose());
091  }
092}
